facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A king loved clothes. He had many outfits. Clothes were his favorite. He loved fine clothes.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Once upon a time, there was an emperor who loved fashion. He spent all his money on beautiful new clothes. He loved fine clothes more than ruling his kingdom. His wardrobe was bigger than most people's houses. Every morning, he tried on outfit after outfit. The people wished he would care more about the kingdom.
facts.Word cards: emperor = 임금님 / clothes = 옷 / loved = 좋아했다 / kingdom = 왕국
